correctness.rationale: The exact source multiplier is used with its published normalization. At gamma=52/27 the global upper inequality reduces to F(t)>=0, and F has an exact power series with its first two coefficients zero and every later coefficient positive. Affinity in gamma plus tanh(x)<x extends strict global maximality at zero to every larger gamma. The exact Taylor coefficient pi^3(52-27 gamma)/648 proves that every smaller gamma fails local maximality at zero. The multiplication-form interpretation makes the essential supremum the best quadratic-form upper constant.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact operator-norm constant of the scale-invariant s-wave multiplier throughout a natural strong-repulsion regime and proves that 52/27 is the sharp locking threshold for the maximizing Mellin frequency. This complements the lower-stability role of the same multiplier and gives a precise continuity constant relevant to norm-equivalence and perturbative estimates; the threshold is structurally forced by the zero-frequency curvature rather than chosen ad hoc.
